status.summary: UFC middleweight champion for the second time: he took the belt from Khamzat Chimaev by split decision at UFC 328 (May 9, 2026). His first reign ran from beating Israel Adesanya (UFC 293, Sep 9, 2023) to losing to Dricus Du Plessis (UFC 297, Jan 20, 2024). Before Chimaev he stopped Anthony Hernandez (TKO R3 2:23, Feb 21, 2026). Pro record 31-7, UFC 18-7 (ESPN, Wikipedia, MMA Junkie). #7 men's pound-for-pound. He hurt his right shoulder in the Chimaev fight and has been out since; he targeted a December return in June. A rematch with Nassourdine Imavov was planned for UFC 335 (Dec 12, 2026) but fell through over a pay dispute (Wikipedia; Yahoo). On Oct 27-28, 2026 MMA Junkie's Mike Bohn reported the rematch is targeted for February 2027 in Florida and 'may even be signed or close to being signed'; Yahoo names UFC 337 as a possible card. It is not officially announced as of Nov 6, 2026.
status.title: UFC middleweight champion
status.ranking: Champion (middleweight); #7 men's pound-for-pound (UFC media panel, Nov 3-5, 2026; read from ufcrankings.org and ufcalendar.com mirrors because ufc.com returned 403).
status.next_fight: Reported, not official: vs Nassourdine Imavov for the UFC middleweight title, targeted for February 2027 in Florida, possibly UFC 337 (Mike Bohn/MMA Junkie via MMA Mania Oct 28 and Yahoo, 2026). An earlier Dec 12, 2026 (UFC 335) plan fell through over his pay dispute.

injuries.what: Right shoulder injury in the Chimaev fight (he threw few right hands late); kept him out for several months. He targeted a December 2026 return, which has not happened.

signature: walks forward behind constant punching: 14.4 sig attempts per minute decayed (middleweight average 8.1), 87% to the head, 96% of landed strikes at distance
out-throws elite opponents over five rounds: 408 sig attempts to Du Plessis's 354 (UFC 297), 312 to Chimaev's 240 (UFC 328, none in R1), 402 to Paulo Costa's 266 (UFC 302)

hurts and then pours it on: knocked Adesanya down in R1 on the way to 49-46 x3 (UFC 293); finished Abus Magomedov (R2, 2023) and Anthony Hernandez (R3, 2026) with ground punches, each time after a knockdown in the same round
gets back up against wrestlers: Chimaev landed 7 takedowns after R1 but held him for only 2:29 across R2-R5
weaknesses: kicks: 59% of what opponents land on him goes to the body or legs (decayed); Costa landed 130 of his 158 there (UFC 302) and Du Plessis 97 of 147 (UFC 312)
rarely wrestles himself (0.41 takedown attempts per 15 min decayed) and his takedown defense is 47.6% decayed; Chimaev went 9 of 13
two KO/TKO losses: Elizeu Zaleski dos Santos (wheel kick, R1, 2018) and Alex Pereira (punches, R1, 2022); three knockdowns absorbed in 25 UFC fights
close fights: five of his last 11 fights were split decisions (3-2 in them)
style.summary: A forward-walking boxer who throws more than almost anyone at middleweight, jabbing and punching to the head from range for five rounds and getting busier as the fight goes on. He barely kicks or wrestles. He gets back up quickly when taken down, which is how he outlasted Chimaev to win the title back. Opponents who kick his legs and body, as Du Plessis and Costa did, are the ones who score on him.

moves.notes: Group shares follow fighters.json decayed sums: sig attempts 87.0% head, 10.7% body, 2.3% leg (career 88.1/9.1/2.8), against a middleweight league split of 77.2/14.0/8.8. He goes to the head far more than average and almost never kicks the legs. 95.6% of his landed sig is at distance, so clinch weights are minimal. In the head group the jab leads and the cross is second: he throws 14.4 sig attempts per minute at 44% accuracy, which fits a jab-heavy volume game, and his jab-led, high-guard boxing is widely described in pre-2026 coverage. No scouting page was opened in this pass to confirm that, so these in-group weights are data-led judgments. The overhand and head kick are near zero because nothing in the data points to looping punches or high kicks. The body straight leads the body group as a judgment; ufcstats does not split body punches from kicks. Leg weights are tiny either way. Spinning is 0.

engine_notes.note: Strongest real late surge in this batch (Chimaev's larger ratios come from his near-zero R1 striking): across 11 five-round fights his R2-R5 output is 1.42, 1.59, 1.67 and 1.86 times R1, against a middleweight curve of 1.26, 1.20, 1.28 and 1.31.

Opponents' landed strikes on him split 40.6% head, 35.7% body and 23.7% leg (decayed). The middleweight league's landed split is 63.9/20.8/15.4, so opponents score on his body and legs far more than usual and on his head far less.
Against Chimaev he spent R1 under 4:47 of control and landed nothing, then out-landed Chimaev 123-98 over R2-R5. A get-up or escape knob for him should be high after the first takedown.
Knockdowns: 1.67 landed decayed, 7 career; 3 absorbed career, none since Pereira in Jul 2022.
